name: Five Guys
covers: Food and drinks in UK restaurants
tips: Most toppings and sauces: Five Guys marks them not suitable for gluten because of how they're prepared, not just their ingredients.
Lettuce wrap: still marked not suitable for gluten because of preparation.
Fries: cooked in peanut oil, which matters if you also have a nut allergy.
gaps: Five Guys doesn't call any item gluten free. Its own legend says it can't guarantee the absence of allergens.
The guide shows gluten as one column, so it doesn't say which cereal an item contains (the ingredient list does).
